# Puntr

> Puntr (puntr.co.za) is a South African sports prediction community and sports intelligence platform. Members post picks on football matches, build a public, verifiable track record, compare themselves with the community on leaderboards, and use research tools. Puntr is not a bookmaker: it takes no bets and holds no stakes. 18+ only. National Gambling Helpline: 0800 006 008.

Key facts:
- Official launch: Tuesday 1 December 2026. Founding Member sign-ups (first 100 members) opened on 2 November 2026.
- Launch coverage: football (soccer) first: Betway Premiership, English Premier League and UEFA Champions League. Other sports follow on the published roadmap.
- Every pick is time-stamped and locked at kick-off; the record of picks is hash-chained and can be checked at /verify.
- Competition points: 3 for a correct match result, 2 for both teams to score, 2 for over/under 2.5 goals. Points rank members only and have no cash value.
- PuntPoints are a loyalty scheme redeemable for vouchers, sponsored rewards and perks, never cash.
- Plans at launch: a free account, Pay-As-You-Go credits for premium tools, and Puntr Pro.
